original_query: Create a stacked bar chart to show the distribution of 'Tax Rate %' and 'Factor' over 'Tax Year'.
optimized_code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
plt.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], label='Tax Rate %', color='steelblue')
plt.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Factor'], bottom=df['Tax Rate %'], label='Factor', color='orange')
plt.title('Stacked Bar Chart of Tax Rate % and Factor Over Tax Years')
plt.xlabel('Tax Year')
plt.ylabel('Values')
plt.legend(loc='upper right')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %', 'Factor'], 'chart_type': 'stackedBarChart'}
plt.show()
